_meta.description: Deterministic numpy-matmul semantic ranker top-5 corpus IDs per nl2bash query. After 2.7.5-hotfix this fixture is pinned to the deterministic algorithm's canonical output (low-index tie-break).
_meta.provenance: Originally generated 2.7.5 from sqlite-vec reference; regenerated 2.7.5-hotfix at HEAD 6aa729e to reflect the deterministic numpy algorithm with low-index tie-breaking via composite-key lexsort. The ~39 tie-affected queries' top-5 sets differ from the original sqlite-vec output but are stable across all runners under the deterministic algorithm. Regenerating requires explicit reasoning about why the reference shifts (e.g. embedder model change, corpus change, tie-break convention change).
